# Concatenate

Joins two arrays into one.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Concatenate(first, second)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `first` | array | The array whose elements come first, left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `second` | array | The array whose elements come after those of first, left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of first in order, followed by the elements of second in order. Never null.

## Example

`Concatenate([1, 2], [3])` returns `[1, 2, 3]`.
